name: TO GOD BE THE GLORY
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (Brightest and Best, 1875) consulted.
reviewNotes: No melody yet: add it from a hymn book you trust (see docs/BLOG.md, "Adding a hymn"), then set the hymn's draft to false. Why it is not encoded: the refrain's 'Praise the Lord' is a dotted quaver and semiquaver, which the half-beat solfa grid cannot show. The 1875 source prints the tune in 3/4, doh A flat; the verse itself fits the grid.
